ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A scientific research ship set out from Shanghai to conduct an investigation of the Southern Hemisphere sea area. Read the hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole. <image1> What is the direction of the ocean current at M?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole S. The South Pole is located at the center of the figure, the meridians are radial, the lower part of the figure is marked 180°, and the lower right is marked 150°; M is located in the high-latitude annular sea area around Antarctica. Reasoning: The sea area where M is located corresponds to the westerly drift around Antarctica, that is, the belt where the Antarctic Circumpolar Current is located. This ocean current is driven by the prevailing westerlies in the Southern Hemisphere and flows from west to east around Antarctica. On a projection map centered on the South Pole, going around Antarctica from west to east appears as a clockwise direction. Therefore, the ocean current direction at M is clockwise.

raw_record.question_text:
A scientific research vessel set out from Shanghai to conduct an investigation of the sea areas in the Southern Hemisphere. Read the hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole.

<image1>

What is the direction of the ocean current at M?

method.method_draft: 先读图：该图是以南极点 S 为中心的南半球投影，M 位于南极周围的高纬度海域环状水域中。再读题干：问的是南半球海域中 M 处洋流的方向。将 M 所在海域识别为南极周围的西风漂流/南极绕极流所在带；该洋流在南半球受盛行西风推动，自西向东环绕南极流动。结合图中南极点居中、经线呈放射状的投影方向，自西向东绕南极表现为顺时针方向，因此答案为“顺时针”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以南极点 S 为中心的半球投影图，南极点位于图中央，经线呈放射状，图下方标有 180°，右下方标有 150°；M 位于南极周围的高纬度环状海域中。推理：M 所在海域对应南极周围的西风漂流，即南极绕极流所在带。该洋流受南半球盛行西风推动，围绕南极自西向东流动。在以南极点为中心的投影图上，自西向东环绕南极表现为顺时针方向。因此，M 处洋流方向为顺时针。

raw_record.original_question:
某科学考察船从上海出发，对南半球海域进行考察。读以南极点为中心的半球投影图。

<image1>

M处的洋流方向是什么？
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole S. The South Pole is located at the center of the figure, the meridians are radial, the lower part of the figure is marked 180°, and the lower right is marked 150°; M is located in the high-latitude annular sea area around Antarctica. Reasoning: The sea area where M is located corresponds to the westerly drift around Antarctica, that is, the belt where the Antarctic Circumpolar Current is located. This ocean current is driven by the prevailing westerlies in the Southern Hemisphere and flows from west to east around Antarctica. On a projection map centered on the South Pole, going around Antarctica from west to east appears as a clockwise direction. Therefore, the ocean current direction at M is clockwise.
